articles.headline: S. Carolina topples UConn behind Tessa Johnson's career-high 32
articles.description: Tessa Johnson scored a career-high 32 points and No. 1 South Carolina shut down seventh-ranked UConn's offense in a 65-56 victory in the Basketball Hall of Fame Women's Showcase.

articles.headline: Tessa Johnson's career-high 32 points lifts No. 1 South Carolina to 65-56 win over No. 7 UConn
